All closed shafts, including vertical exit enclosures, having a floor area exceeding 4 square feet (0.37 m 2 ) shall be provided with a smoke vent in accordance with Sections 713.12.1.1 through 713.12.1.3. Interior vertical exit shaft enclosures shall also comply with Chapter 10.
   Exceptions:
      1.   Elevator and dumbwaiter shafts in accordance with Chapter 30.
      2.   Interior exit stairways and ramps constructed as smokeproof enclosures in accordance with Section 1023.11.
